Therapeutic Use of DXM
I have been taking 150mg of DXM daily for 6 weeks along with 20mg Prozac and 10mg valium 2 times per day. I have social anxiety, panic disorder and mild obsessive compulsive disorder. I have found this drug to be very therapeutic for mood stabilization.
I have taken this dose in my wifes third trimester of her pregnancy. She is very moody, emotional and hormonal. The DXM seems to have helped me keep my calm and accept when she is irrational. I just seem to say all the right things at the right time remain calm and avoid arguments. Everything appears to be a bit brighter and clearer. I have a heightened awareness of whats going on around me and I just know how to react the right way in each situation I am confronted with.  A little anxiety has occurred but I treated it with my doctors dose of 10mg of valium.
